Doktor biće srećan kada vidi recenziju!

Dear,

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are genuinely sorry that your experience did not meet your expectations.

When you contacted us, we offered you the earliest available appointment. Later, an earlier time slot became available, and we contacted you immediately to offer you that appointment.

Unfortunately, our root canal specialist was not available that day, and we informed you of this in advance. In addition, root canal treatment is a complex procedure that typically takes around two hours and often requires more than one visit. As we understood, you did not have enough time to complete this treatment before your return to the Netherlands.

We would also like to explain that scheduled treatments in our clinic are usually booked approximately two weeks in advance. Unless there is a cancellation, it is unfortunately not possible to offer an earlier appointment.

After your initial examination, our oral surgeon saw you as an emergency patient and removed the tooth, as this was the safest and most appropriate way to eliminate the source of infection and prevent further complications.

We understand that you were hoping to receive root canal treatment, and we sincerely regret that this was not possible under the circumstances. Thank you for your understanding. We wish you a speedy recovery and all the best for your health.

Марине и Карену будет безумно приятно увидеть такой положительный отзыв. Мы всегда рады быть вам полезны! С уважением, команда Dental Expert.
